dedupe_keys.name: ev managed charging supply curve python package

description: The managed-charging research team publishes an installable Python package that generates and queries electric-vehicle program cost supply curves. The GitHub README documents SupplyCurves methods for participation steps, cost tables and cost-per-vehicle queries. It covers time-of-use pricing, real-time pricing and direct load control; vehicle and flexibility scenarios run from 2025 to 2050. The repository declares a BSD 3-Clause licence and public access is free. This economic model can feed demand-flexibility choices into grid-capacity or optimisation studies with model-pypsa after converting vehicle costs to power capacity. A caveat is that willingness-to-enroll curves and incentive costs reflect the paper's assumptions, not measured participation in every utility territory. Vehicle mix, charger rating and tariff rules must be adapted before local application. Own metadata, README and tree were read without installing the package or comparing generated tables with its separate static Zenodo CSV release.
